name: Sony A5100
notes: First target body. Tested on firmware 3.10 with a Sigma 30mm F1.4 DC DN (tools/camera-test.sh --photos): the settings behind each yes were read back from the camera after the app set them and show in the EXIF of a photo shot with them; the lens name and focal length (tenths of a mm) were read from the body. soft_skin is accepted and read back, but the test photos had no face, and the body records Off then. self_timer is only confirmed off. auto_iso_range is no: setISOAutoMin/Max do not exist on firmware 3.10 (firmware report) and fail on the body.
